name: After recital 1 – 94
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council on speeding-up environmental assessments
part_text: (1a) The intensification of heatwaves and the periods of extreme heat affecting the European Union are the result of a lack of environmental preparedness, and no new project should be authorised without the challenges of adapting to climate change having been taken into account.
